title: The Perfect Central Square
setup: A black knight on b6 and a bishop on d2 stand unguarded, but your queen cannot take either yet. Find the square that attacks both.
hint: A queen attacks along files and diagonals at once. Look for the square where a file to one piece meets a diagonal to the other.
explanation:
## The Idea

From {{Qd4}} the queen hits the bishop on d2 straight down the file and the knight on b6 along the diagonal. Neither black piece attacks d4, and neither guards the other.

Black's best try props the knight up with the bishop from a5. The queen simply steps to c5 and hits both again, and one of them still falls.

Any other move gives Black time to tidy both pieces away.
